## Is your feature request related to a problem?

A clear and concise description of what the problem is. e.g., "I'm always frustrated when ..."

## Describe the solution you'd like

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Describe alternatives you've considered

Other approaches or workarounds you've thought about.

## Persona

Which user does this help most?
- [ ] Trader (intraday F&O, scalping)
- [ ] Investor (mutual funds, SIPs, portfolio tracking)
- [ ] Beginner (guided learning, paper trading)
- [ ] Developer (contributor, integrator)

## Additional context

Screenshots, mock-ups, links to similar features in other platforms, etc.
